dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
In her foster home, Bootsy is affectionately known as "Bootsy the hungry ghost". She is a tiny, quiet presence who prefers to watch the world from the sidelines. In spite of her small size, food is definitely the way to Bootsy's heart - this cat can EAT! We have seen Bootsy come out of her shell slowly but surely and believe she will be a sweet, quiet companion to anyone who is able to give her the space, privacy, and safety she needs to thrive.
dog.name: Bootsy
